rawItems.title: SoftBank Group put 67% of U.S. portfolio into Intel stock
rawItems.summary: The Japanese investment group held 86.9 million Intel shares worth $12.1 billion as of June 30, dwarfing all other U.S. equity positions
rawItems.body:
SoftBank Group disclosed in a 13F filing that Intel stock represented nearly 67% of its disclosed U.S. equity portfolio as of June 30, 2026, with the position totaling 86,956,522 shares valued at $12,141,739,167.
The filing, submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission, places Intel far ahead of SoftBank's next-largest U.S. holdings. Symbotic stock came in second at around $1.79 billion, or roughly 10% of the total, while T-Mobile U.S. stock added another $1.68 billion, or about 9%, according to Yahoo Finance. The remainder of the portfolio — a collection of fintech names including Klarna, Chime, eToro, Nu Holdings, and Inter & Co — amounted to a marginal slice of the whole.
The Intel position reflects a substantial escalation of SoftBank's existing exposure to the chipmaker. SoftBank Group chair Masayoshi Son's firm had previously committed a $2 billion strategic investment into Intel that closed in the third quarter of 2025, according to Yahoo Finance.
Intel's second-quarter fiscal 2026 results showed revenue of $16.128 billion, a 25.4% increase from the prior-year period, with the Data Center and AI segment posting a 59% gain to reach $6.262 billion. For the third quarter of 2026, Intel set a revenue outlook of $15.8 billion to $16.8 billion.
SoftBank's Intel bet figures into a broader picture of gains and losses at the Japanese conglomerate. The firm reported first-quarter net income of 347.3 billion yen, or approximately $2.2 billion, driven by a 1.3 trillion yen gain on Intel stock. Intel stock has risen close to 400% on a year-over-year basis. SoftBank's cumulative investment in OpenAI is expected to reach approximately $64.6 billion upon completion of a third planned tranche in October 2026, representing an ownership stake of roughly 13%, the company said.
The 13F filing covers positions held as of June 30. Institutional money managers with more than $100 million in U.S. equities must submit the form no later than 45 days after each quarter's close. Even measured against SoftBank's well-documented history of outsized single-asset wagers, the Intel stake is notable: in raw dollar terms, it exceeds the combined value of every other U.S. equity position the firm disclosed.

rawItems.body:
Key Points
-
Interested in DLocal Limited? Here are five stocks we like better.
-
DLocal delivered record second-quarter results: Total payment volume surged 92% year over year to $17.7 billion, while gross profit rose 29% to $127 million and net income increased 28% to $55 million.
-
Growth was led by ride-hailing and merchant expansion across travel, remittances, e-commerce and delivery, with local-to-local transactions reaching 61% of TPV. Brazil and Argentina posted record gross profit, although Mexico and some African and Asian markets faced margin pressure.
-
The company raised its full-year outlook, now expecting TPV growth of 60%–70% and gross-profit growth of 25%–30%, while maintaining operating-profit growth guidance of 27.5%–32.5%. Management also highlighted increasing AI-driven automation, a planned merchant-of-record product and continued share repurchases.
DLocal (NASDAQ:DLO) reported second-quarter 2026 total payment volume of $17.7 billion, up 92% from a year earlier, as growth in ride-hailing, travel, remittances, e-commerce and other verticals drove record volume and gross profit.
Chief Executive Officer Pedro Arnt said the company processed more volume in the quarter than it did during all of 2023. The result marked DLocal's fastest TPV growth since the first quarter of 2022 and extended its streak of growth above 50% year over year to seven consecutive quarters.
→ AST SpaceMobile Earnings Just Reminded Investors How Risky Space Can Be
Gross profit rose 29% year over year to $127 million, while operating profit increased 15% to $64 million. Net income reached $55 million, up 28% from a year earlier, and diluted earnings per share were $0.18.
Volume growth led by ride-hailing and merchant expansion
Arnt said the company's merchant relationships continued to deepen, with clients adding countries, payment methods and products. DLocal reported net revenue retention of 153% and TPV retention of 188% during the quarter. The company said it serves more than 760 global merchants across more than 60 emerging markets.
→ Nebius' Q2 Beat Shows the AI Bottleneck Is Capacity, Not Demand
Ride-hailing was the largest contributor to sequential TPV growth, according to Chief Financial Officer Guillermo Lopez Perez. While one large global merchant was an important driver, he said growth was also supported by several ride-hailing and on-demand-delivery companies expanding meaningfully.
Travel, remittances, e-commerce, software-as-a-service and advertising also added to growth. Financial-services volumes were modestly lower, which Lopez Perez attributed primarily to seasonality among certain travel-related merchants in Latin America.
→ On Holding's Price Stumble May Be an Opening for a Company Built to Run
Local-to-local flows represented 61% of TPV, up 6 percentage points from the first quarter. The shift reflected rapid growth in ride-hailing and on-demand-delivery activity, which typically requires local settlement.
During the question-and-answer portion of the call, Arnt said the rapid expansion of a large global ride-hailing merchant had pushed the company into "a whole new tier" of volume. He added that, excluding that merchant and certain currency-volatility effects, net take rate would have been close to flat sequentially even as TPV growth would have remained above 65% year over year.
Arnt said high-volume merchant ramp-ups can lead clients to reach lower pricing tiers more quickly, reducing headline take rates while still generating incremental gross profit. He said DLocal is focused on growing TPV and gross profit rather than managing to a specific take-rate target.
Regional results and margins
Brazil and Argentina were the principal contributors to gross-profit growth. Brazil generated record gross profit of $40 million, supported by ramp-ups in ride-hailing and travel merchants and continued e-commerce growth. Argentina produced record gross profit of $20 million, driven by e-commerce, ride-hailing and on-demand delivery, as well as lower advancement costs.
Elsewhere in Latin America, gross profit increased 6% sequentially and 32% year over year. Mexico continued to post strong volume growth, though gross profit declined modestly from the prior quarter. Arnt said Mexico's revenue rose 64% year over year, but costs as a percentage of TPV increased slightly as DLocal was unable to reduce processing costs enough to offset lower pricing. He said the company needs to improve cost management and negotiations with processing partners in that market.
Gross profit in Africa and Asia declined sequentially, mainly because of a smaller contribution from higher-spread markets including Mozambique and Vietnam. Lopez Perez said first-quarter gains in those markets were not necessarily recurring.
Total operating expenses were $63 million, up 46% from a year earlier but down 4% sequentially. The year-over-year increase reflected the annualization of second-half 2025 investments, higher average salaries following the annual merit cycle, selected senior hires and marketing spending concentrated in the first half, including a World Cup campaign and merchant events.
Operating profit represented 50% of gross profit, up 6 percentage points sequentially. Lopez Perez said DLocal does not expect material headcount increases for the remainder of the year.
Automation initiatives and product expansion
Management said it expects operating leverage to become more visible in the second half as marketing spending eases, prior-period items do not recur and the company deploys automation and artificial-intelligence initiatives.
Arnt said more than 60% of DLocal's code is AI-generated, contributing to nearly doubled engineering deployments year over year and shorter software-development lead times. The company expects automation to support efficiency across engineering, compliance, operations, commercial functions and customer support.
DLocal also plans to launch dMOR, its merchant-of-record solution, which would allow the company to act as the legal seller on a merchant's behalf. Arnt said the offering is designed to handle local entity setup, tax filings and other statutory requirements in addition to payments. Its buy-now, pay-later offering is currently live in eight markets.
Company raises TPV and gross-profit outlook
Following first-half performance, DLocal raised its full-year TPV growth outlook to 60% to 70% year over year and increased projected gross-profit growth to 25% to 30%.
The company maintained its operating-profit growth outlook of 27.5% to 32.5%. Arnt said the unchanged operating-profit guidance reflects a $4.4 million prior-year tax item recorded in first-quarter operating expenses and foreign-exchange headwinds relative to the assumptions in its original forecast.

rawItems.body:
US stocks traded mixed on Wednesday after PCE data showed inflation remained sticky in the lead-up to the Fed's Jackson Hole gathering and as investors counted down to Nvidia's (NVDA) earnings report.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average (^DJI) declined by 0.2%, while the S&P 500 (^GSPC) and tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) slipped below the flat line after posting broad gains on Tuesday.
Meta stock (META) rose after the company agreed to settle a social media addiction trial for roughly $16.7 billion. The case revolved around allegations from 29 states that Meta developed products to hook young users, misled consumers about their safety, and improperly collected personal data.
After the closing bell, Nvidia reported its quarterly results and offered a strong third quarter outlook, buoying the artificial intelligence trade. The AI bellwether also defended its public and private investments, with CEO Jensen Huang saying on the earnings call, “the only regret that I have is that I didn't invest more and sooner.”
Markets assessed a new reading of inflation, meanwhile, from the Federal Reserve's preferred gauge. The core Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Index, which excludes the volatile food and energy categories, rose 3.3% in July, which was in line with expectations and unchanged from the month before.
That update on mild inflation comes amid angst in the bond market and ahead of the Jackson Hole annual gathering of Fed policymakers this week, where Chairman Kevin Warsh will deliver a speech on the central bank's future plans.
Abercrombie & Fitch (ANF) also reported earnings on Wednesday morning, posting a guidance raise that lifted the stock 35%. After the closing bell, Salesforce (CRM) stock surged 13% following better-than-expected guidance.
- Grace O'Donnell
Stocks edge lower as investors brace for Nvidia earnings
US stocks were little changed in the countdown to Nvidia’s (NVDA) earnings report after the bell, a bellwether for the artificial intelligence trade.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average (^DJI) declined by 0.2%, while the S&P 500 (^GSPC) and Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) fell fractionally.
Chip stocks were mixed on Wednesday. Nvidia shares fell 1.6%. In other earnings movers, Abercrombie & Fitch stock soared 35% after posting an earnings beat and guidance raise.
Here’s a look at the day’s sector action, according to an AlphaSpace heatmap:
- Grace O'Donnell
Meta's settlement is a challenge to TikTok and YouTube
The cost of doing business as a global social media company just got a little higher, Yahoo Finance’s Hamza Shaban writes. He explains that Meta’s (META) social media addiction settlement includes explicit provisions encouraging other social media companies to adopt the limits Meta has agreed to.
Hamza writes:
Participating states, for instance, will receive about 70% of the allocated payment over a decade. But the remaining 30% will be released only after two specific conditions are met. The first is that YouTube and TikTok implement a 1-hour daily limit, a restricted night mode, and age-verification measures. And the second is that each of the companies pays about $5.3 billion to fund youth online safety initiatives. If YouTube and TikTok pay up, so will Meta.
Several safety measures will also be strengthened should YouTube and TikTok sign on. The incentive structure works like this: Meta pays into a pot that its rivals must also contribute to. And while its engagement figures for young people will likely fall, it won't be at a relative disadvantage if those measures are adopted by its largest rivals.
For YouTube and TikTok, entering into the agreement would bolster their defenses in future legal battles. That could potentially shield them from other lawsuits and penalties related to teen social media addiction. And conversely, if they refuse to agree, they expose themselves to accusations that they aren't following sensible safety practices. Signing on to the pact would also collectively restrict companies from deploying the controversial practices that got Meta in trouble in the first place.
- Grace O'Donnell
Revolution Medicines' newly approved cancer drug 'will be one of the most rapid drug launches ever': Analysts
The FDA approved a pancreatic cancer therapy from Revolution Medicines (RVMD), marking a major breakthrough for treating one of the most difficult cancers to cure.
Revolution Medicines’ stock gained less than 1% on Wednesday and is up 167% year to date, with a big pop in April following positive signs of efficacy in its late-stage trial for Rasonque.
“This will be one of the most rapid drug launches ever,” a team of TD Cowen analysts wrote in a note.
The analysts noted that Rasonque received the FDA green light six and a half months ahead of schedule due to its efficacy, which has altered medical practice.
Earlier this month, the team wrote, Revolution disclosed that over 2,000 patients were already taking the drug under the FDA’s expanded access program, which allows patients with life-threatening conditions to try experimental therapies when no other alternative is available.
“Using a very conservative $20K/month price, the >2K EAP patients alone equate to $500MM of annual sales, which should continue to grow rapidly well beyond that number,” the TD Cowen analysts wrote. “Management indicated that transitioning EAP to commercial is a key priority, though it will take a few months to convert every patient. Thus, we expect a significant bolus translating to significant first and second quarter 2027 sales.”
“Given the hockey-stick-like expected revenue ramp, the early approval and robust EAP use meaningfully pull forward timing to profitability,” they added.
- Jake Conley
FAA orders inspections of some Boeing Dreamliner jets
Boeing (BA) shares were largely unchanged after news that the FAA is requiring engineering inspections of some of the company's flagship Dreamliner jets.
Shares initially fell about 1% but quickly bounced back to previous levels, settling at a loss of about 0.3% as investors evaluated the FAA's airworthiness directive.
An investigation by Boeing itself through the summer "concluded that shim gaps may have exceeded engineering allowances, and high pull up forces on the components may cause fatigue cracks to form at the fastener holes," per the FAA, which led the FAA to require inspections.
The gaps "can grow to weaken primary wing structure until it cannot sustain limit load and result in subsequent loss of continued safe flight and landing," the FAA wrote.
- Grace O'Donnell
Social media stocks fall in response to Meta settlement
Snap (SNAP), Roblox (RBLX), and other social media stocks are falling in reaction to the Meta (META) landmark social media addiction trial settlement, with Snap stock plunging over 8%.
Meta stock, meanwhile, gained over 1% as traders weighed what the settlement implies for the company's social media empire.
"These companies are just too big to be meaningfully affected by these kinds of settlements," Bloomberg Intelligence Head of Technology Research Mandeep Singh said about Meta's penalties in the case, which could reach $16.68 billion.
Though the story is different for companies like Snapchat and Roblox, which cater to younger users, Singh said.
Pennsylvania's AG is also suing Snapchat over alleged harms to children.
"From that perspective, the fact that everyone is focused on this demographic — users under 16 — and how these social media platforms are impacting their behavior, I think that's a negative in terms of engagement," Singh noted.
- Grace O'Donnell
Abercrombie & Fitch stock soars 36% as retailer sees 'momentum' in back-to-school shopping
Abercrombie & Fitch (ANF) stock soared 36% after the company reported robust second quarter results and significantly raised its financial outlook for the remainder of the year.
The apparel retailer said it didn’t lower prices as much as it expected in the second quarter — notable as other retailers have called out a highly promotional environment — and said its products are resonating with shoppers, driving the outperformance in Q2.
“We've got momentum headed into and through back to school, and that's carrying us into August and Q3,” Abercrombie CFO Robert Ball said on the company’s earnings call. “So we're excited to be positioned to drive another quarter here, 5%-6% growth on the top line and double-digit operating margins.”
In Q2, Abercrombie reported net income per share of $4.17, inclusive of a $1.75 benefit from tariff refunds. That surpassed Wall Street analyst expectations for earnings of $1.97, per S&P Global Market Intelligence. Revenue of $1.27 billion also beat estimates of $1.25 billion.
Abercrombie shared a more upbeat outlook for the remainder of the year.
For the full year, Abercrombie now expects net sales growth of around 5%, up from a previous range of 3% to 5%. Net income per share is expected to come in at $13.10-$13.60, above the previous range of $10.20-$11.00.
- Jake Conley
Oil prices drop as Iran and Oman announce agreement to share Hormuz revenues
Oil prices ticked down on Wednesday after news that Iran and Oman, both of which border the critical Strait of Hormuz, have agreed to share revenues derived from the waterway's operations.
Futures on Brent crude (BZ=F), the international benchmark, fell by 0.6%, while those on the US benchmark West Texas Intermediate (CL=F) ticked down by roughly 0.8% on the news.
"Agreements have been reached regarding each country's share of the strait's waters as well as Iran and Oman's share of its revenues," the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' spokesperson Hossein Mohebbi said on Wednesday, per state-run Sepah News agency.
The news comes after a previous announcement on Wednesday that Tehran and Muscat were engaging in talks on an "interim framework" to resume some shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, to include de-mining efforts.
That said, Iranian leaders have repeatedly asserted that such an agreement — the details of which remain scant — would not equate to a full reopening of the waterway, which Iran says can't happen until the US ends its naval blockade.
- Grace O'Donnell
Meta stock wavers after company settles social media addiction trial
Meta (META) reached a settlement in a social media addiction trial on Wednesday, ending a landmark case centering on claims that the company developed products to addict children to its platforms.
The stock initially surged on the announcement but then pared gains in early trading. The trial posed risks to Meta’s business, no matter the outcome of the case.
The social media company agreed to pay $16.7 billion in penalties and to make changes to its platforms, such as establishing daily limits and nighttime use blocks for teenagers, enhancing age-verification measures to prevent children from accessing the platform, and creating additional tools to help parents and guardians protect their children.
Meta denied any wrongdoing in the case, which was brought by 29 states.
- Grace O'Donnell
Stocks turn lower at the open following PCE inflation data
Stocks dipped into the red at the open on Wednesday as PCE inflation data was in line with expectations and investors awaited Nvidia (NVDA) earnings after the bell for the latest update on the AI ecosystem.
Meta stock (META) rose 0.6% after the company agreed to settle with 29 states over social media addiction claims, ending a trial that just entered its second week.

PCE shows prices edge just slightly edge up above expectations
The Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge showed prices heated up slightly faster than expected in July, as all eyes turn to Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole speech on Friday.
The Personal Consumption Expenditures index rose 3.7% year over year in July, just above expectations of 3.6%, and in line with June's yearly gain. Month over month, prices rose 0.2%, just above expectations of 0.1% growth and a turnaround from June's 0.1% slowdown.
Excluding volatile energy and food prices, the way the Fed prefers to assess the inflation gauge, "core" PCE rose 3.3% year-on-year, in line with expectations, and the increase seen in June. Month over month, core inflation rose 0.2%, in line with estimates.

Nvidia's (NVDA) stock isn't having its typical year, Yahoo Finance’s Brian Sozzi writes. He notes:
No epic gains on earning reports. Nvidia stock has fallen in response to earnings in six of the past eight quarters, including the last four, per Yahoo Finance AlphaSpace analysis.

- Jared Blikre
Nvidia earnings could reveal its fastest-growing business isn't chips
Wall Street is focused on Nvidia's (NVDA) graphics processing units (GPUs). The faster-growing story is sitting beside them.
Nvidia has quietly built a networking operation that generated nearly $15 billion last quarter, up from roughly $3 billion per quarter two years ago. Wall Street expects that figure to approach $17 billion when the company reports earnings on Wednesday.
Compute still dwarfs networking inside Nvidia's Data Center business. But networking has been growing faster, up nearly 200% year over year in the last quarter compared with 77% for compute.
That pace is slowing. Analysts expect networking growth of roughly 134% in the quarter about to be reported, still ahead of compute at about 100%.

AI's next big bottleneck isn't infrastructure. It's regulatory red tape.
As Big Tech has poured hundreds of billions of dollars into artificial intelligence development, myriad bottlenecks have given investors reason to worry, from multiyear delays in natural gas turbine deliveries to capital availability and energy access constraints.
However, with midterm elections just two months away, the biggest bottleneck is elsewhere, according to Melius Research — in regulation.
"The binding constraint on growth has shifted," James West, managing director at Melius Research, wrote to clients on Monday. "It is no longer turbines, capital, or customer intent: rolling into midterms, it is permission."
West's argument underscores the growing role of politics in the US's AI infrastructure build-out. As resistance to data center development has grown in communities across the country, state governments have increasingly clamped down, pursuing legislation that slows construction.

rawItems.title: How Nvidia silenced the bears
rawItems.summary: Nvidia served up a key outlook.
rawItems.body:
With Nvidia's (NVDA) stock stuck in neutral for the better part of the summer as investors have fretted about peak artificial intelligence growth, the chip darling decided to take one swift measure to silence the naysayers.
The action: serving up a rare long-term outlook that blew everyone on the Street away.
Nvidia said late Wednesday after reporting its fiscal second quarter earnings that it sees 70% revenue growth for fiscal year 2028. This was above analyst forecasts for 45% growth. The sales gain would be larger if not for memory chip shortages, said Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.
"The first ever year ahead guidance is the real news," Stifel analyst Ruben Roy wrote in a note. "We think the more revealing point is why they guided at all. Management framed it as getting customers, shareholders and the supply chain onto the same set of information, which in our view makes this as much a supply-chain coordination device as a forecast, and reassure suppliers to commit capacity and customers that BoM inflation was being absorbed too via the fiscal year 2028 ~72-73% gross margin guide (down from mid-70% prior)."
Shares of Nvidia rose nearly 8% in premarket trading on the results and upbeat outlook. Prior to the earnings report, Nvidia shares had slightly underperformed the S&P 500's year-to-date gain of about 14%.
To be sure, the company's fiscal second quarter warranted a strong long-term outlook that may end up proving conservative.
Nvidia saw adjusted earnings per share of $2.22 on revenue of $96.2 billion. These were better than the $2.09 a share the Street had expected and revenue of $92.3 billion.
Nvidia's Data Center revenue, which includes Hyperscalers and AI Clouds, Industrial, and Enterprise (ACIE), came in at $89 billion versus a projected $85.8 billion.
Edge Computing, which includes Nvidia's other businesses, such as physical AI and gaming, brought in $7.2 billion. Analysts were expecting $6.6 billion.
Nvidia projected fiscal third quarter revenue of between $105.8 billion and $110.1 billion. Wall Street was calling for $105.1 billion.
This would be the first quarter above $100 billion in revenue for Nvidia, Stifel's Roy said.
"Nvidia's earnings call reinforced exceptionally strong AI growth," Citi analyst Laura Chen wrote in a note.

rawItems.body:
[딜사이트 차화영 기자] 이환주 KB국민은행장이 KB금융지주 차기 회장 최종 3인 후보군에 들지 못했다. 그룹 최대 계열사인 KB국민은행의 현직 수장이라는 점에서는 아쉬운 결과지만, 이번 탈락만으로 후계 구도에서 밀려났다고 단정하기는 이르다는 평가가 나온다. 이 행장은 아직 은행장 임기가 진행 중인 데다 은행과 보험, 지주를 두루 경험한 경력을 갖추고 있어서다. 특히 양종희 회장의 연임 가능성이 높게 점쳐지는 상황에서 이번보다 3년 뒤 차기 회장 인선이 이 행장에게 본격적인 승부처가 될 수 있다는 관측도 나온다.
1일 금융권에 따르면 KB금융 회장후보추천위원회(회추위)는 지난달 27일 차기 회장 후보 6명을 대상으로 1차 심층 인터뷰를 진행한 뒤 후보군을 3명으로 압축했다. 내부에서는 양 회장과 이재근 KB금융 부문장이, 외부에서는 권광석 전 우리은행장이 최종 경쟁에 합류했다. 이 행장과 이창권 KB금융 부문장, 익명을 요청한 외부 후보 1명은 탈락했다.
이 행장의 탈락은 그룹 최대 계열사를 이끄는 현직 행장이라는 점에서 눈길을 끈다. KB국민은행은 KB금융의 이익에서 가장 큰 비중을 차지하는 핵심 계열사다. 이 때문에 국민은행장 자리는 그룹 최대계열사의 영업력과 리스크 관리 능력을검증받는 자리로 회장 후보로 올라서는주요 경로 가운데 하나로 꼽혀왔다.
이번 인선에서 이 행장이 최종 3인에 오르지 못한 배경을 단순히 경쟁력 부족으로 해석하기 어려운 이유도 있다. 이 행장은 2025년 국민은행장에 올라 아직 핵심 계열사 최고경영자(CEO)로서 경력을 쌓아가는 단계다. 2022년부터 2024년까지 3년간 국민은행장을 지낸 뒤 지주 부문장으로 이동한 이재근 부문장과는 경력의 단계가 다르다. 핵심 계열사 최고경영자(CEO)로서 쌓을 경력이 더 남아있는 셈이다.
은행 실적 역시 이 행장의 향후 경쟁력을 가늠할 주요 지표가 될 전망이다. KB국민은행은 지난해 순이익 기준 ‘리딩뱅크’ 자리를 되찾은 데 이어 올해 상반기에는 전년 동기보다 1.7% 증가한 2조2254억원의 순이익을 냈다.
경력만 놓고 보면 이 행장은 회장 후보에게 필요한 조건을 상당 부분 갖췄다는 평가를 받는다. 1991년 주택은행에 입행해 KB국민은행 개인고객그룹 전무, 경영기획그룹 부행장 등을 지냈고 지주 재무담당(CFO) 부사장을 거쳐 2023년 KB라이프생명 초대 대표에 올랐다. KB생명과 푸르덴셜생명의 통합 작업을 마친 뒤 2025년 국민은행장으로 자리를 옮겼다.
은행 영업과 경영기획뿐 아니라 지주 재무, 보험사와 은행 CEO를 모두 경험한 셈이다. 특히 비은행 계열사를 직접 경영한 경험이 없는 이재근 부문장과 비교하면 보험사 CEO 경력은 이 행장의 차별점이다. 이 행장은 KB금융에서 비은행 계열사 CEO를 거쳐 국민은행장에 오른 첫 사례이기도 하다.
앞으로 지주에서 그룹 단위의 사업을 총괄하는 경험까지 더할 수 있느냐도 주목할 부분이다. KB금융 회장 후보군에서는 개별 계열사 경영뿐 아니라 그룹 전체 사업 포트폴리오를 다뤄본 경험이 중요한 경쟁력으로 평가되기 때문이다.
양 회장이 걸어온 길 역시 하나의 참고 사례다. 양 회장은 KB손해보험 대표를 지낸 뒤 2021년 지주 부회장으로 이동해 약 3년간 보험, 글로벌, 디지털 등 그룹 주요 사업을 맡은 뒤 2023년 회장에 선임됐다. 이 행장 역시 향후 지주로 이동해 그룹 주요 사업을 총괄할 기회가 주어진다면 경력의 마지막 퍼즐을 채울 수 있다. 양 회장과 순서는 다르지만 은행·비은행·지주를 모두 경험한 회장 후보로서 경력 구성을 완성할 수 있다는 전망이다.
이 때문에 금융권에서는 이번 탈락보다 3년 뒤 이 행장을 주목하는 시각도 있다. 이번 1차 후보군에 포함된 내부 인사 가운데 양 회장을 제외하면 이재근·이창권 부문장은 이미 계열사 CEO를 거쳐 현재 지주에서 경력을 이어가고 있다. 반면 이 행장은 국민은행장으로서 핵심 계열사 경영 성과를 추가로 쌓을 시간이 남아 있다.
물론 3년 뒤 인선 구도를 현시점에서 예단하기는 어렵다. 그럼에도 이 행장이 현직 은행장으로서 추가적인 경영 성과를 축적하고 향후 지주 경험까지 확보할 경우 이번보다 두터운 경력을 갖춘 채 다음 회장 인선에 나설 여지는 충분하다는 평가다. 이번 최종 3인 탈락이 다른 내부 후보들의 탈락과 다소 다른 의미로 읽히는 배경이다.
회추위는 오는 11일 양 회장과 이재근 부문장, 권광석 전 우리은행장을 대상으로 2차 심층 인터뷰를 진행한 뒤 최종 후보자 1명을 선정한다. 최종 후보자는 법령상 자격 검증과 이사회 추천, 주주총회 등을 거쳐 차기 회장으로 선임된다.

[데일리한국 손희연 기자] KB·신한·하나·우리금융지주의 비은행 경쟁이 보험 부문에서 가열되고 있다. 은행에 집중된 수익구조를 다변화하고 안정적인 비은행 수익원을 확보하기 위해서다.
이미 KB금융이 KB손해보험과 KB라이프를 앞세워 보험 계열사에서 안정적인 이익을 내며 한발 앞선 가운데 우리금융은 동양생명과 ABL생명의 통합을 공식화했다. 신한금융과 하나금융도 상대적으로 취약한 보험 부문의 경쟁력을 끌어올리는 데 공을 들일 것으로 보인다.
◇ KB손보·라이프 상반기 순익 6294억원…생·손보 균형 포트폴리오 구축
2일 4대 금융지주의 올해 상반기 경영실적 보고서에 따르면 KB금융은 4대 금융 중 보험 부문에서 가장 앞서 있다. KB손해보험은 올해 상반기 4788억원의 순이익을 거뒀고 KB라이프는 1506억원을 기록했다. 두 회사의 순이익을 합치면 6294억원에 달한다. KB손해보험의 순이익은 지난해 같은 기간보다 14.2% 감소했지만 여전히 계열 보험사 가운데 가장 많다.
KB금융의 강점은 생명보험과 손해보험을 모두 대형 보험사로 키웠다는 데 있다. 과거 LIG손해보험을 인수해 KB손해보험으로 성장시킨 데 이어 푸르덴셜생명을 품고 KB생명과 통합해 KB라이프를 출범시키면서 생·손보를 아우르는 포트폴리오를 완성했다.
증권과 보험 등 비은행 계열사가 은행 실적을 보완하는 구조도 자리잡았다. KB금융은 올해 상반기 비은행 계열사의 그룹 이익 기여도가 44%까지 올라왔다. 신한금융은 35%, 우리금융은 22.3%, 하나금융은 18.8% 수준이다. 특히 우리금융은 동양생명과 ABL생명 편입 효과 등에 힘입어 비은행 이익 비중이 지난해 상반기 6.9%에서 올해는 22.3%로 크게 확대됐다.
◇ 신한, 생보 강하지만 손보 적자…M&A 가능성 열어둬
신한금융은 생명보험에서는 강하지만 손해보험이 상대적으로 약하다. 신한라이프는 올해 상반기 2906억원의 순이익을 기록했다. 전년 동기보다 15.6% 감소했지만 KB라이프(1506억원)보다 1400억원을 앞섰다. 신한라이프의 보유계약 보험계약마진(CSM)도 6월 말 7조9000억원으로 지난해 상반기 말보다 8.9% 증가했다.
신한EZ손해보험은 상반기 182억원의 순손실을 내며 지난해 같은 기간 157억원 적자보다 손실 규모가 확대됐다. 신한라이프와 신한EZ손해보험을 단순 합산하면 신한금융 보험 계열사의 상반기 순이익은 약 2724억원이다. KB금융 보험 계열사 합산 순익의 절반에도 미치지 못한다.
신한금융이 롯데손해보험 인수에 나섰던 것도 손해보험 부문을 보완하기 위한 전략과 맞닿아 있다. 신한금융은 롯데손보 최대주주인 JKL파트너스와 인수 협상을 진행했지만 가격에 대한 이견을 좁히지 못하면서 단독 협상이 결렬됐다. 롯데손보는 공개매각 수순에 들어갔다.
다만 신한금융의 손해보험 M&A 가능성 자체가 사라진 것은 아니다. 신한금융은 적정한 매물이 나올 경우 M&A를 검토할 수 있다는 입장이다. 자체적으로 신한EZ손보를 육성하는 동시에 적절한 매물이 등장할 경우 인수를 검토하는 투트랙 전략을 이어갈 것으로 보인다.
장정훈 신한금융 CFO(최고재무책임자)는 올해 2분기 경영실적발표 컨퍼런스콜에서 “롯데손보뿐 아니라 다양하게 어떤 매물들이 그룹에 도움이 될 수 있을지 검토하고 있다”며 “현재까지는 확정된 것은 없다”고 밝혔다.
◇ 우리, 동양·ABL생명 통합 자산 55조 생보사 출범…하나도 보험 체질개선
우리금융은 보험 부문에서 가장 빠른 외형 확대에 나서고 있다. 우리금융 연결 실적에 반영된 동양생명의 올해 상반기 순이익은 981억원으로 전년 동기보다 12.2% 증가했다. ABL생명은 167억원으로 48.0% 감소했다. 두 보험사가 거둔 순이익은 총 1148억원이다.
우리금융은 단순히 두 보험사를 보유하는 데 그치지 않고 통합작업에 들어갔다. 지난해 7월 동양생명과 ABL생명을 계열사로 편입한 데 이어 지난달 동양생명을 100% 완전자회사화 했다. 이어 2027년 하반기 두 회사를 합쳐 총자산 55조원 규모의 대형 생명보험사를 출범시킬 계획이다.
통합이 완료되면 우리금융 보험사는 자산 기준 생명보험업계 5위권으로 올라설 전망이다. 동양생명이 강점을 가진 보장성보험과 ABL생명의 저축성보험을 결합하고 우리은행의 방카슈랑스 고객 기반까지 활용하면 그룹 차원의 시너지도 확대할 수 있다. 우리금융은 통합 보험사를 그룹의 핵심 성장축이자 주력 계열사로 육성한다는 방침이다.
하나금융은 보험 계열사의 수익성 개선이 가장 큰 과제로 꼽힌다. 하나생명은 올해 상반기 146억원의 순이익을 거뒀다. 반면 하나손해보험은 711억원의 순손실을 기록했다. 이를 단순 합산하면 하나금융 보험 계열사는 상반기 약 565억원의 적자를 낸 셈이다.
하나생명의 경우 변액보험 계정대체 효과가 확대됨에 따라 2분기 이자이익(2조3030억원)은 8.1% 감소했다. 2분기 변액보험 계정대체 효과는 2931억원이다. 하나손보의 적자 확대는 금융당국의 계리적 가정 가이드라인 변경 영향이 컸던 것으로 풀이된다.
하나금융은 당장 보험사를 추가로 인수하기보다는 장기보험과 판매채널을 확대하는 등 하나손보 자체 경쟁력을 높이는 집중할 것으로 보인다. 다만 적정 매물이 나올 경우 M&A를 검토할 가능성도 열려 있다.
남호식 하나금융 CSO(최고전략책임자)는 2분기 경영실적 발표 컨콜에서 “오거닉(자체 성장)과 인오거닉(M&A)을 특별히 구분하지 않고 모두 열어두고 있다”며 “당분간 각 계열사의 본업 경쟁력과 그룹 시너지 강화에 집중하면서 성장 기회를 검토해 나갈 계획이다”고 말했다.
금융지주들이 보험 경쟁력을 끌어올리려는 움직임은 앞으로도 이어질 전망이다. 은행의 이자이익만으로 성장하기 어려워지는 상황에서 보험은 증권과 함께 그룹의 수익원을 다변화할 수 있는 핵심 비은행 사업이기 때문이다.

rawItems.body:
지방공항 기피하는 은행들… 인천 입점엔 '수백억 베팅'
시중銀 공항 입점 전략 양극화
금융 서비스 수요 비대면 이동
영업점·환전소 수익성 떨어져
브랜드 노출효과 큰 인천 빼면
지방공항 소극적 입찰 불가피
시중은행들의 공항 입점 전략이 양극화 양상을 보이고 있다. 인천국제공항 은행 영업권을 놓고 수백억원대 임대료 경쟁을 벌인 은행들이 지방공항에서는 좀처럼 지갑을 열지 않고 있어서다. 금융 서비스 수요가 비대면으로 이동하면서 공항 점포의 수익성이 떨어진 데다 브랜드 노출 효과가 상대적으로 크지 않다는게 시중은행들의 판단이다.
■지방공항 기피하는 은행들
31일 한국공항공사에 따르면 김해국제공항 은행 영업점 및 환전소 운영사업자 입찰 참가 등록이 지난 18일 오후 4시에 마감됐다.
이번 입찰은 현재 김해공항에서 영업 중인 BNK부산은행과의 계약 종료를 앞두고 진행되는 것이다. 지난 7년간 김해공항에서 영업점과 환전소를 운영해온 부산은행은 기존 계약을 연장할 수 있었지만 새로운 조건으로 계약을 체결하기 위해 연장 대신 재입찰을 택한 것으로 알려졌다. 4대 은행 중 이번 김해공항 입점 입찰에 참여한 은행은 한 곳도 없는 것으로 파악됐다.
현재 김해공항에서 영업점·환전소를 운영하는 은행은 부산은행뿐이다. 신한은행도 과거 김해공항에 입점했었지만 수익성 등을 고려해 2022년 철수했다. 이후 시중은행이 새로 들어오지 않으면서 지방 거점 국제공항임에도 지역은행 한 곳만 자리를 지켜왔다.
이는 주요 은행들이 인천국제공항 영업권 확보에 적극적으로 나서는 것과 대조적이다. 지난 2023년 은행들은 인천공항 점포 사업권을 따내기 위해 연간 수백억원에 달하는 임대료를 제시하는 등 치열한 경쟁을 벌였다. 당시 KB국민은행은 연간 700억원의 임대료를 제시해 500억원대를 제시한 신한은행을 제친 바 있다. 계약 기간이 최대 10년에 달하는 점을 고려하면 공항 영업권을 확보하는 데 상당한 비용을 감수한 셈이다.
반면 지방 공항들은 분위기가 다르다. 지난 2018~2019년 김포·청주공항 사례가 대표적이다. 당시 영업점 선정 과정에서 은행들의 참여가 저조한 탓에 두 공항 모두 입찰이 여섯 차례 유찰된 바 있다. 결국 한국공항공사는 임대료를 절반 이상 낮춰 신한은행과 수의계약을 맺는 식으로 정리했다.
김해공항도 과거에는 여러 은행이 사업권 확보에 관심을 보였지만 최근에는 수익성 문제로 입찰 열기가 예전만 못하다는 게 금융권의 설명이다. 2012년만해도 하나금융지주 계열이었던 외환은행이 김해공항 영업권 입찰에서 연간 80억원가량의 임대료를 제시할 정도로 경쟁은 치열했다. 이번 입찰에서 김해국제공항이 제시한 연간 최소 임대료(69억4319만원)보다 높은 금액이다.
■김해, 이용객 증가에 은행 돌아설까
지방공항이 시중은행들로부터 외면받는 건 막대한 비용에 비해 수익성이 크지 않기 때문이다. 이번 김해공항의 계약기간은 5년으로, 최소 금액으로 낙찰되더라도 347억원 이상의 임대료를 부담해야 한다. 입점을 원하는 은행은 국제선 영업점과 환전소, 국내선 라운지, ATM 등 총 270.84㎡를 일괄 계약해야 한다. 은행 판단에 따른 일부 시설의 중도 해지는 불가능하다는 점도 부담으로 꼽힌다.
환전 방식이 달라지면서 오프라인 환전소의 매력이 떨어지고 있다는 점도 은행들이 지방공항 입점을 꺼리는 요인으로 거론된다. 과거에는 출국 직전 공항 영업점이나 환전소에서 외화를 바꾸는 고객이 많았지만 최근에는 모바일 애플리케이션을 통한 환전과 외화 충전식 카드 등이 빠르게 확산돼 이용 고객이 줄어드는 추세다.
사실 인천공항도 수익성 부담은 다르지 않다는 평가가 나온다. 그럼에도 은행들이 인천공항에서 수백억원의 임대료를 감수하는 것은 단순한 환전 수익보다 국내 최대 관문이라는 상징성과 브랜드 노출 및 외국인 고객 선점 효과가 크기 때문이다.
이에 최근 김해공항의 국제선 이용객이 늘어나면서 은행들의 셈법이 달라질 가능성도 있다. 올해 상반기 김해공항 국제선 이용객은 607만명으로 지난해 같은 기간보다 23.2% 증가해 역대 최대를 기록했다. 특히 이중 외국인 이용객은 207만9222명으로 사상 처음 상반기 기준 200만명을 넘어섰다.
은행권 관계자는 "공항은 영업점 자체의 수익성만 보고 들어가는 사업은 아니다"라며 "2023년 당시 국민은행이 높은 임대료를 써내면서까지 사업권을 확보한 데는 인천공항이 갖는 상징성과 브랜드 효과가 크게 작용했을 것"이라고 설명했다.
